licenses.text:
Η Καινή Διαθήκη, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/grcmt/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/grcmt/copyright.htm):
> The Greek New Testament according to the Byzantine Text form. Robinson-Pierpont 2018 edition
> Public Domain
> Language: Ελληνικά (Greek, Ancient)
> Dialect: Koine
> Translation by: Maurice A. Robinson and William G. Pierpont
> This public domain Bible translation is brought to you courtesy of eBible.org.
> If you would like to make a donation to help keep free Bible access like this going, please visit https://eBible.org/give.php.
> 2024-01-09

Why this is public domain:
Text: the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform Greek New Testament, 2018 edition, United States. The Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform's notice reads: "This compilation is Copyright (C) 2018 by Maurice A. Robinson. Anyone is permitted to copy ... All rights to this text are released to everyone" (https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf; the 2005 edition's notice, https://byzantinetext.com/?p=111, is the same in substance). The maintainer's decision (2026-10-16): a copyright line beside a full release of all rights counts as a public-domain dedication. Editors: Maurice A. Robinson (living, United States) and William G. Pierpont.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grcmt), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grcmt/copyright.htm), https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf; https://byzantinetext.com/?p=111.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-grcmt-440febfa, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
